CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.data_export_worker_candidate_v5(v jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$ select jsonb_build_object('displayName',private.data_export_scalar_v5(v->'displayName','string'),'bio',private.data_export_scalar_v5(v->'bio','string'),'skills',private.data_export_array_v5(v->'skills','string'),'tools',private.data_export_array_v5(v->'tools','string'),'licenses',private.data_export_array_v5(v->'licenses','string'),'vehicles',private.data_export_array_v5(v->'vehicles','string'),'teamCapacity',private.data_export_scalar_v5(v->'teamCapacity','number'),'location',jsonb_build_object('operatingCountryCode',private.data_export_scalar_v5(v#>'{location,operatingCountryCode}','string'),'city',private.data_export_scalar_v5(v#>'{location,city}','string'),'radiusKm',private.data_export_scalar_v5(v#>'{location,radiusKm}','number'),'approximatePosition',jsonb_build_object('latitude',private.data_export_scalar_v5(v#>'{location,approximatePosition,latitude}','number'),'longitude',private.data_export_scalar_v5(v#>'{location,approximatePosition,longitude}','number'))),'availability',jsonb_build_object('timezone',private.data_export_scalar_v5(v#>'{availability,timezone}','string'),'availableNow',private.data_export_scalar_v5(v#>'{availability,availableNow}','boolean'),'rules',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',private.data_export_scalar_v5(x->'id','string'),'startTime',private.data_export_scalar_v5(x->'startTime','string'),'endTime',private.data_export_scalar_v5(x->'endTime','string'),'startsOn',private.data_export_scalar_v5(x->'startsOn','string'),'endsOn',private.data_export_scalar_v5(x->'endsOn','string'),'label',private.data_export_scalar_v5(x->'label','string'),'active',private.data_export_scalar_v5(x->'active','boolean'),'weekdays',private.data_export_array_v5(x->'weekdays','number')) order by ordinal) from jsonb_array_elements(case when jsonb_typeof(v#>'{availability,rules}')='array' then v#>'{availability,rules}' else '[]'::jsonb end) with ordinality as a(x,ordinal) where jsonb_typeof(x)='object'),'[]'::jsonb),'windows',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',private.data_export_scalar_v5(x->'id','string'),'startsAt',private.data_export_scalar_v5(x->'startsAt','string'),'endsAt',private.data_export_scalar_v5(x->'endsAt','string'),'state',private.data_export_scalar_v5(x->'state','string'),'label',private.data_export_scalar_v5(x->'label','string')) order by ordinal) from jsonb_array_elements(case when jsonb_typeof(v#>'{availability,windows}')='array' then v#>'{availability,windows}' else '[]'::jsonb end) with ordinality as a(x,ordinal) where jsonb_typeof(x)='object'),'[]'::jsonb))) $function$
